You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: Begin by moving the yellow_mug from the purple_box to the cyan_tray, as the purple_box must be cleared before placing the red_block. Then, place the red_block into the purple_box. Ensure that each object is placed only in its designated zone. Success is achieved when the red_block is in the purple_box and the yellow_mug is on the cyan_tray, with no objects left on the desk surface.
Goals: [{"object": "red_block", "zone": "purple_box"}, {"object": "yellow_mug", "zone": "cyan_tray"}]

Current scene (from the camera):
{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_block": {"kind": "block", "center": [-0.0759, -0.2013, 0.8199], "top_z": 0.8399, "height": 0.0399, "footprint_long": 0.0398, "footprint_short": 0.0395, "long_axis_yaw": 1.215}, "yellow_mug": {"kind": "mug", "center": [0.015, -0.0135, 0.837], "top_z": 0.874, "height": 0.074, "footprint_long": 0.0518, "footprint_short": 0.0457, "long_axis_yaw": -1.477}}, "zones": {"orange_tray": {"name": "orange_tray", "center": [0.0983, -0.2169, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0649, 0.0649]}, "cyan_tray": {"name": "cyan_tray", "center": [0.0575, 0.1762, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0649, 0.0649]}, "purple_box": {"name": "purple_box", "center": [0.0185, -0.026, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0556, 0.0556]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0795, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1979, -0.0005, 1.08], "yaw": 1.499}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
Reply with JSON only:
{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
